annual.note: Amounts in USD millions; shares in millions. Primary financial statements and debt/share notes checked in the filed document. Restricted cash is not an excess asset. Operating leases remain operating expenses and are not deducted again as financial debt. Stock compensation remains in operating expenses; outstanding awards are also reflected as current ownership claims. Filed dated-group basis includes Mobility until June 30, 2026; Mobility was separated effective July 1, 2026. This result is not standalone post-separation SPGI and must not be compared directly with its current quote. Redeemable NCI is a material separate claim. Affiliates carrying value is context only because related earnings are already in EBIT.
